business_summary: Daiei Kankyo Co., Ltd. engages in the waste management and valuable resource recycling businesses in Japan. It is involved in the waste management and recycling, soil remediation, forest management, aluminum pellets, facility construction and administration, and consulting services, forest management, as well as generates electricity through biogas and solar. The company also engages in the other waste-related businesses, including the provision of temporary staffing and recruitment services, as well as agribusiness; and sports promotion and management businesses. In addition, it offers aluminum and recycled plastic pallets. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan. Daiei Kankyo Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Wingtowa Co., Ltd.
